scenes.say: Is honey actually healthier than sugar? If you have diabetes, the answer might surprise you.
scenes.headline: HONEY VS SUGAR
scenes.sub: Which is better for blood sugar?

scenes.say: Honey, maple syrup, agave, coconut sugar. They all sound natural.
scenes.headline: "NATURAL" SWEETENERS

scenes.say: But your body counts every single one of them as added sugar.
scenes.headline: THEY'RE ALL ADDED SUGAR

scenes.say: One tablespoon of honey has about seventeen grams of carbs. White sugar has about twelve.
scenes.headline: CARBS PER TABLESPOON

scenes.say: So spoon for spoon, honey can add even more carbs to your day.
scenes.headline: MORE CARBS, NOT FEWER

scenes.say: Agave is lower on the glycemic index, but it's mostly fructose, and it's still added sugar.
scenes.headline: AGAVE? STILL SUGAR

scenes.say: The real win isn't switching sweeteners. It's using less of all of them.
scenes.headline: USE LESS OF ALL OF THEM

scenes.say: Did you think honey was healthier? Tell us in the comments, and follow for more diabetes friendly food tips.
scenes.headline: DID YOU THINK HONEY WAS HEALTHIER?
